IGUI_MVM_ConfirmReportLost:
Unclaim %1 as lost?
It is unclaimed after %2 hours and stays claimed until then. If the server sees the vehicle in that time, this is cancelled.
This only frees your slot; admins are not notified.
IGUI_MVM_ReportLost_Tip: Use this when the vehicle was destroyed, disappeared or can't be found and you can't get to it: it is unclaimed after %1 hours and frees your slot, and stays claimed until then. If the server sees the vehicle, this is cancelled (it still exists, so unclaim it next to it). Admins are not notified.
IGUI_MVM_ConfirmCancelRebind:
Unclaim %1?
This vehicle has not moved over from the old mod yet (the server has not seen it). Unclaiming frees the slot now, and it will no longer be handed to you; if the vehicle still exists, anyone can claim it, including you.
IGUI_MVM_ConfirmDismiss: Permanently delete the history entry for %1?

Claim this vehicle?
Others can't drive, open, refuel or strip it unless you share it.
IGUI_MVM_ClaimRisk_1: Weapons, zombies and crashes can still damage it.

IGUI_MVM_ClaimRisk_3: If you have a free guard slot, this vehicle gets damage guard automatically (guard slots %1 / %2). Without it, weapons, zombies and crashes can still damage it.
